svg.title: Rapid oscillation near zero
svg.desc: The bounded outputs continue swinging between -1 and 1 in every neighborhood of zero, so no limit exists. Two explicit branches of y = sin(1/x) are drawn for negative and positive x near zero. The curve remains between -1 and 1 but swings more rapidly as x approaches zero. Neither domain includes zero, no segment connects across zero, and every neighborhood contains many high and low values instead of one approached height. Separate left and right solid branches leave a visible break at x = 0, and a text annotation names the infinite oscillation. Caption: The function sin(1/x) oscillates increasingly rapidly near zero and has no limit there. Reading order: oscillation-left: Solid oscillating branch stops before zero.; oscillation-right: Solid oscillating branch starts after zero.; oscillation-note: Text identifies the endless oscillation near the hard domain break..
